name: Repo Retriever
description: Stitches call graphs, resolves indirect calls, and extracts source-to-sink taint flows.

skills.name: Stitch Indirect Calls
skills.description: Resolve function pointers, callbacks, and interfaces to connect broken call chains.
examples: Resolve struct function pointers and dynamic dispatch targets on disk

skills.name: Extract Taint Flows
skills.description: Trace production entry points to critical operations and write taint-flow-xxx.jsonl.
examples: Extract complete candidate flows from chunk-flow-xxx.jsonl to taint-flow-xxx.jsonl
